subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 status, pen-test report request & vuln disclosure plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@medivault.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 status, pen-test report request & vuln disclosure plan

Hi Sara — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep the security review moving: 

1) SOC 2 status
- You asked for SOC 2 Type II evidence. We can share our SOC 2 summary report and the secure artifact portal link. If you need the full opinion letter, we can provide it under an NDA.

2) Pen test / vulnerability reports
- We can share a redacted pen-test summary immediately. Full handback (raw report) requires a standard NDA and an internal review to remove customer-specific findings.
- Proposed disclosure SLA: acknowledge critical issues within 48 hours, remediation plan for criticals within 30 days; high within 60 days; medium/low within 90 days. We’re flexible if you have a stricter requirement.

3) Scanning cadence and certifications
- External pentest: annual + ad-hoc for major releases.
- Internal/automated scanning: weekly SCA + monthly authenticated scans on our pre-prod.

4) Vendor questionnaire
- You mentioned a vendor security questionnaire — please share the doc link. We’ll assign Aditya and Vanessa to respond; Vanessa will handle the technical answers and artifacts.

Attachments we can share after a quick NDA: redwood-soc2-summary-2024.pdf, redwood-pt-disclosure-policy.pdf (policy contains our triage & disclosure timeline).

Next steps I propose:
- You send the vendor questionnaire link (or upload to your secure questionnaire portal)
- We get a signed NDA for full pen-test handback if needed
- 30-minute follow-up with Vanessa to walk through answers and clarify residual risk

Would Wednesday morning PST or Thursday afternoon PST work for a follow-up?

Best,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary-2024.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)]

Thanks Kimberly — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: We need the Type II period (start/end) and whether logs are retained for 12 months by default. Also confirm whether Redwood supports EU data residency (even if our first deployment will be US).

- Pen-test: We typically request the last two pen-test reports (redacted is fine) and a statement of whether any critical issues are outstanding. We also require a vendor signature on an NDA before full report handback.

- Questionnaire: uploading it now — link below. Please fill the doc and flag any items you can’t answer.

--- Questionnaire link ---
https://docs.google.com/document/d/medivault-vendor-questionnaire

Can you confirm who will own the questionnaire responses and whether the follow-up call can include a technical walkthrough of the pen-test handback process?

Thanks,
Sara Li
Head of Security Operations
Medivault

Kim / team — copying the security leads with a proposed internal plan to respond to Medivault. Notes below are internal-only: 

1) SOC 2 artifact handling- We have a SOC 2 Type II (period: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31). Logs retained 14 months; retention policy note attached. We can share the SOC 2 summary (artifact) publicly and full report under NDA. Attach: redwood-soc2-summary-2024.pdf.

2) Pen test handback policy- We completed an internal + external pen test in 2026-11. No outstanding criticals from that engagement. We can provide: 
  - Immediate: redacted executive summary
  - After NDA: full report 
- Suggested disclosure/triage SLAs: acknowledge within 24-48 hours; critical remediation plan in 30 days; high in 60; med/low in 90. For critical production-impacting issues, we’ll offer temporary mitigations and patch guidance.

3) Questionnaire ownership- Aditya will own the questionnaire completion for the architecture and feature questions. I (Vanessa) will own technical artifacts (scan outputs, pen-test summary, disclosure policy). Neha will coordinate portal access and DocuSign.

4) Attachments we can provide now: redwood-soc2-summary-2024.pdf, redwood-pt-disclosure-policy.pdf. If the customer requires full raw evidence (scan logs, raw vuln output), we need a narrow-scope NDA and the executed vendor agreement.

5) Proposed next steps (internal)
- Assign Aditya to respond in the questionnaire within 48 hours.
- Prepare DocuSign NDA and share link to Sara.
- Schedule 30-minute technical walkthrough with Medivault (Vanessa + Neha + Aditya).

If that timeline works I’ll prep the artifacts for sharing and the NDA template.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
